services.text: WP Care helps with WordPress setup, hosting and domain basics, updates, backups, diagnostics, small fixes, and ongoing website support.

pricing.text: Pricing depends on the website and the scope of support.

process.text: Describe the website and the requested result, receive a scope and estimate, then approve the work before implementation.

limits.text: We do not promise unlimited support, undefined large projects, or work outside the agreed scope.

contact.text: Use Request a quote to send your details and describe the task.
